svg.aria-label: The Orrery Queue: the planner writes jobs into one queue on the Mac; the keeper hands each free lane its next job over ssh; nine CPU lanes play the game's census and three GPU lanes evolve crucible's nets; every job comes back as a file the planner reads; what holds goes onto the line and then treadcore's main, and an elected net ships to nets/. The console draws all of it.
